name: The agent never asks before it acts
description: approval_policy = never drops the prompt that stands between a command the agent composed and the machine it runs on. Every escalation the sandbox would have referred to a human is taken automatically instead. The token is read under approval_policy alone: a custom permission profile is named without the colon the built-ins carry, so a profile could be named never and declare the opposite posture.
message: The agent never asks before it acts
